problem: Let $X$ be the number obtained by a fair spinner with six sections labeled $-3,-1,2,3,5,12.$ What is $\text{Var}[X]?$

feedback.problem:
Let $X$ be the outcome of rolling an unfair tetrahedral  die that follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. What is $\text{Var}[X]?$

| $x$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{3}{8}$ | $\frac{3}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ |
feedback.worked_solution:
The variance of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{Var}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}(x-\text{E}[X])^{2}\cdot f(x).
$$

First, we need to compute $\text{E}[X].$ Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4) \\  & =1(\frac{3}{8})+2(\frac{3}{8})+3(\frac{1}{8})+4(\frac{1}{8}) \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting $\text{E}[X]=2$ into the variance formula, we get

$$
\text{Var}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}(x-2)^{2}\cdot f(x).
$$

Now, we compute the variance as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X] & =(1-2)^{2}\cdot f(1)+(2-2)^{2}\cdot f(2)+(3-2)^{2}\cdot f(3)+(4-2)^{2}\cdot f(4) \\  & =f(1)+0+f(3)+4\cdot f(4) \\  & =(\frac{3}{8})+0+(\frac{1}{8})+4(\frac{1}{8}) \\  & =1\end{aligned}
$$
